title: A Stochastic Flow for the Stochastic Allen-Cahn Equation with Multiplicative Noise
summary: We establish the existence of a stochastic flow on $L^{\infty} (\mathbb{T})$ for the stochastic Allen-Cahn equation with multiplicative noise \[ (\partial_t - \partial_x^2) u = u - u^3 + σ(u) ξ\quad \text{on} \quad \mathbb{R}_+ \times \mathbb{T}, \] where $ξ$ is space-time white noise and $σ: \mathbb{R} \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ is sufficiently smooth, bounded, and has bounded derivatives. Our strategy is to obtain pathwise a priori estimates via regularity structures.
